name: Anika
label: Artist-pay conscious music fan
who: I pay for Premium and think it is underpriced for the full history of recorded music. I care a lot about how much artists and rights holders get paid and I compare services on that basis.
value_for_money: Strongly positive. Says the full catalog for about $10 a month is an incredible deal, and argues that the price should be higher in light of what artists are paid.
loyalty: Stays because paying for Premium feels like the fair way to support artists and get an ad-free catalog. Has considered artist-friendlier services such as Tidal for that reason.
pain_points: Artists are paid too little per stream
Tidal's artist payout plan is not really in place
Songs getting shorter, paying per song rather than per minute
Audiobook prices on Spotify are high
likes: Full catalog for a low monthly price
tone: Thoughtful and argumentative, often building a case with numbers and comparisons to CDs.
